new_papers.title: Counterfactual Causal Inference in Natural Language with Large Language Models
new_papers.local_path: docs/papers/Counterfactual Causal Inference in Natural Language with Large Language Models Gendron(2024).pdf
new_papers.cutoff_status: First-page identity and PDF version stamp inspected; matched API version date no later than cutoff
claims: The method extracts causal graphs and natural-language variable states from text, then uses an LLM for structural-mechanism computations and counterfactual propagation.
The authors separate graph-building error from inference error; providing the correct graph does not reliably remove numerical/logical errors.
Limitations include DAG-only structure, omitted confounders, parsing failures, cost, and real-world counterfactual values proxied by the LLM.
new_papers.inspection_scope: Explicit selected passages, not an assertion that every page was reviewed.

anchors.section: Section 3 text graph and LLM mechanisms

adverse_findings_and_limits: A model-supplied counterfactual cannot serve as independent validation of that same model.
Text stating a causal relation is evidence of a claim, not empirical evidence that the claim holds.
A fixed graph without identified mechanisms is insufficient for arbitrary counterfactual answers.
new_papers.project_disposition: Use as a critical comparison; perform counterfactual arithmetic in verified tools and require an identified query.

preserved_source.local_path: docs/papers/CausalDS Benchmarking Causal Reasoning in Data-Science Agents Leban(2026).pdf
preserved_source.cutoff_status: First-page identity and PDF version stamp inspected; matched API version date no later than cutoff
claims: CausalDS provides narrated synthetic SCM scenes, data files, a separate observation model and private scoring artifacts.
Interventional and counterfactual targets have separate identification decisions, with abstention on nonidentifiable tasks.
The paper reports a 100-scene exam sampled from 953 scenes and finds that symbolic success, interval quality, abstention and cost can diverge.
preserved_source.inspection_scope: Explicit selected passages, not an assertion that every page was reviewed.
adverse_findings_and_limits: Identification is defined for conceptual variables; the paper explicitly distinguishes their noisy observed proxies. An adapter must preserve this distinction.
The reported leaderboard is a dated author evaluation, not evidence of model performance or costs measured here.
A generated story with hidden ground truth is a useful test setting, but does not establish authentic bank semantic/assignment truth.
preserved_source.project_disposition: High-priority candidate benchmark architecture; inspect generator and scoring before any reuse, retaining failures and repeatability.
preserved_source.filename_title: CausalDS Benchmarking Causal Reasoning in Data-Science Agents

supported_claims: PopulationATE and counterfactual identification are separate gates; conceptual law differs from noisy observed proxies.
Public scene files and private truth/scoring are separated; reported model results are not local replication.
